name: Nạp văn bản pháp lý xây dựng từ Drive vào Supabase
description: Ingest tài liệu pháp lý xây dựng do cơ quan nhà nước ban hành từ Google Drive vào kho pháp lý dùng chung toàn CIC. Có idempotency, OCR theo batch, version bất biến, chunk lineage, embedding và complete-only publication.

nodes.name: Legal Ingestion Config
nodes.notes: Fail-closed runtime configuration; never reuses a product folder.

nodes.name: List Legal Drive Folder
nodes.notes: Lists only supported files from the dedicated trusted legal folder.

nodes.name: Normalize Legal Drive Files
nodes.notes: Loại file không hỗ trợ, loại trùng theo Google Drive file ID và sắp xếp ổn định trước khi vào loop.

nodes.name: Prepare Legal Source Metadata
nodes.notes: Allowlist, 50 MB bound, stable Drive identity and source hash.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data), b AS (SELECT data,(data->>'organization_id')::uuid organization_id FROM input),
doc AS (
 INSERT INTO legal_documents(organization_id,document_type,title,language_code,source_type,source_external_id,source_url,file_name,mime_type,content_hash,status,is_official,metadata)
 SELECT organization_id,'construction_legal_document',data->>'file_name','vi','google_drive',data->>'file_id',data->>'source_url',data->>'file_name',data->>'mime_type',data->>'source_hash','processing',false,jsonb_build_object('corpus',data->>'corpus','drive_modified_time',data->>'modified_time') FROM b
 ON CONFLICT(organization_id,source_type,source_external_id) DO UPDATE SET source_url=excluded.source_url,file_name=excluded.file_name,mime_type=excluded.mime_type,content_hash=excluded.content_hash,metadata=legal_documents.metadata||excluded.metadata
 RETURNING *
), complete AS (
 SELECT v.id FROM legal_document_versions v,doc d WHERE v.document_id=d.id AND v.source_content_hash=d.content_hash AND v.is_current=true AND v.parse_status='completed' AND v.chunk_status='completed' AND v.embedding_status='completed' AND v.index_status='completed' LIMIT 1
), active_other AS (
 SELECT r.id FROM legal_ingestion_runs r,doc d WHERE r.document_id=d.id AND r.operation_key<>d.organization_id::text||':'||d.source_external_id||':'||d.content_hash AND r.status='processing' AND r.updated_at>=now()-interval '12 hours' LIMIT 1
), claimed AS (
 INSERT INTO legal_ingestion_runs(organization_id,operation_key,source_external_id,source_content_hash,document_id,status,metadata)
 SELECT d.organization_id,d.organization_id::text||':'||d.source_external_id||':'||d.content_hash,d.source_external_id,d.content_hash,d.id,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM complete) THEN 'skipped' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'failed' ELSE 'processing' END,jsonb_build_object('workflow_id','Bzi9dHprJPgP54H2') FROM doc d
 ON CONFLICT(operation_key) DO UPDATE SET attempt_count=legal_ingestion_runs.attempt_count+1,status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM complete) THEN 'skipped' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'failed' ELSE 'processing' END,error_code=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'DOCUMENT_BUSY' ELSE null END,error_message=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'another source version is processing' ELSE null END,started_at=now(),completed_at=null
 WHERE legal_ingestion_runs.status='failed' OR (legal_ingestion_runs.status='processing' AND legal_ingestion_runs.updated_at<now()-interval '12 hours')
 RETURNING *
), run_row AS (
 SELECT c.*,true AS claimed_by_this_execution FROM claimed c UNION ALL SELECT r.*,false AS claimed_by_this_execution FROM legal_ingestion_runs r,doc d WHERE r.operation_key=d.organization_id::text||':'||d.source_external_id||':'||d.content_hash AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM claimed) LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.data->>'organization_id' organization_id,b.data->>'corpus' corpus,b.data->>'file_id' file_id,b.data->>'file_name' file_name,b.data->>'mime_type' mime_type,(b.data->>'size_bytes')::bigint size_bytes,b.data->>'source_url' source_url,b.data->>'source_hash' source_hash,b.data->>'language_code' language_code,b.data->>'modified_time' modified_time,d.id::text document_id,r.id::text run_id,c.id::text completed_version_id,
 CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'skipped' WHEN r.claimed_by_this_execution AND r.status='processing' THEN 'process' ELSE 'busy' END action
FROM b CROSS JOIN doc d CROSS JOIN run_row r LEFT JOIN complete c ON true;

nodes.name: Reserve Legal Source
nodes.notes: Idempotent organization+Drive file+hash reservation with stale-run recovery.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{status:$json.action==='busy'?'busy':'skipped',reason:$json.action==='busy'?'same source is already processing':'same source hash already completed',file_id:$json.file_id,file_name:$json.file_name,document_id:$json.document_id,document_version_id:$json.completed_version_id||null}}];

nodes.name: Prepare Legal Office OCR Batches
nodes.notes: Splits DOCX by logical OOXML body blocks and PPTX by slides before Gemini OCR; prunes unreachable package assets and caps oversized batches.

nodes.name: Loop Over Legal OCR Batches
nodes.notes: Runs one page batch at a time so Gemini retries are independent per batch.

nodes.name: Encode Legal OCR Batch
nodes.notes: Converts only the current loop batch to base64, avoiding whole-file base64 duplication in execution data.

nodes.name: Gemini Legal Document OCR
nodes.notes: One Gemini request per page batch; each batch retries independently up to four attempts.

nodes.name: Throttle Legal OCR Requests
nodes.notes: Waits five seconds between successful OCR batches to stay below Gemini free-tier request-rate limits.

nodes.name: Normalize Legal Extracted Text
nodes.notes: Preserves page markers and rejects empty/truncated extraction.

nodes.name: Prepare Legal Metadata Request
nodes.notes: 18k-character bounded metadata sample; full source remains authoritative.

nodes.name: Extract Legal Metadata Qwen
nodes.notes: Metadata only; deterministic downstream validator rejects unsupported values.

nodes.name: Validate Legal Metadata
nodes.notes: Every extracted string/date must be supported by filename or source; effective is never inferred.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data), b AS (SELECT data,(data->>'document_id')::uuid document_id,(data->>'run_id')::uuid run_id FROM input),
doc_update AS (
 UPDATE legal_documents d SET metadata=d.metadata||jsonb_build_object('pending_source_hash',b.data->>'source_hash')
 FROM b WHERE d.id=b.document_id RETURNING d.*
), next_version AS (SELECT coalesce(max(v.version_number),0)+1 n FROM legal_document_versions v,b WHERE v.document_id=b.document_id),
version_upsert AS (
 INSERT INTO legal_document_versions(document_id,organization_id,version_number,source_content_hash,extracted_text,normalized_text,parse_status,chunk_status,embedding_status,index_status,is_current,extraction_method,extracted_fields)
 SELECT b.document_id,(b.data->>'organization_id')::uuid,n.n,b.data->>'source_hash',b.data->>'raw_text',b.data->>'normalized_text','completed','processing','processing','pending',false,'gemini_ocr_batched',jsonb_build_object('extraction',coalesce(b.data->'extraction','{}'::jsonb),'legal_metadata',coalesce(b.data->'legal_metadata','{}'::jsonb),'metadata_sample_chars',coalesce((b.data->>'metadata_sample_chars')::int,0)) FROM b CROSS JOIN next_version n
 ON CONFLICT(document_id,source_content_hash) DO UPDATE SET extracted_text=excluded.extracted_text,normalized_text=excluded.normalized_text,parse_status='completed',chunk_status='processing',embedding_status='processing',index_status='pending',is_current=false,extraction_method=excluded.extraction_method,extracted_fields=excluded.extracted_fields
 WHERE NOT (legal_document_versions.is_current AND legal_document_versions.parse_status='completed' AND legal_document_versions.chunk_status='completed' AND legal_document_versions.embedding_status='completed' AND legal_document_versions.index_status='completed')
 RETURNING *
), selected AS (SELECT * FROM version_upsert UNION ALL SELECT v.* FROM legal_document_versions v,b WHERE v.document_id=b.document_id AND v.source_content_hash=b.data->>'source_hash' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM version_upsert) LIMIT 1),
deleted_embeddings AS (DELETE FROM legal_chunk_embeddings e USING legal_document_chunks c,selected s WHERE e.chunk_id=c.id AND c.document_version_id=s.id AND NOT s.is_current RETURNING e.id),
deleted_chunks AS (DELETE FROM legal_document_chunks c USING selected s WHERE c.document_version_id=s.id AND NOT s.is_current AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_embeddings)>=0 RETURNING c.id),
run_update AS (UPDATE legal_ingestion_runs r SET document_version_id=s.id,status='processing',metadata=r.metadata||jsonb_build_object('metadata_validated',true) FROM selected s,b WHERE r.id=b.run_id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM deleted_chunks)>=0 RETURNING r.id)
SELECT b.data->>'organization_id' organization_id,b.data->>'corpus' corpus,b.data->>'file_id' file_id,b.data->>'file_name' file_name,b.data->>'mime_type' mime_type,b.data->>'source_url' source_url,b.data->>'source_hash' source_hash,b.data->>'language_code' language_code,b.document_id::text document_id,b.run_id::text run_id,s.id::text document_version_id,b.data->'legal_metadata' legal_metadata FROM b CROSS JOIN selected s;

nodes.name: Begin Legal Document Version
nodes.notes: Creates or safely resets only an incomplete source-hash version; completed versions are immutable.

nodes.name: Chunk Legal Document
nodes.notes: 3500-character/500-chunk bounds with original page and article lineage.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data)
INSERT INTO legal_document_chunks(document_version_id,organization_id,chunk_index,section,article_ref,page_start,page_end,title,content,normalized_content,language_code,token_count,content_hash,metadata)
SELECT (data->>'document_version_id')::uuid,(data->>'organization_id')::uuid,(data->>'chunk_index')::int,nullif(data->>'section',''),nullif(data->>'article_ref',''),nullif(data->>'page_start','')::int,nullif(data->>'page_end','')::int,data->>'title',data->>'content',data->>'normalized_content',coalesce(data->>'language_code','vi'),(data->>'token_count')::int,data->>'content_hash',coalesce(data->'metadata','{}'::jsonb) FROM input
ON CONFLICT(document_version_id,chunk_index) DO UPDATE SET section=excluded.section,article_ref=excluded.article_ref,page_start=excluded.page_start,page_end=excluded.page_end,title=excluded.title,content=excluded.content,normalized_content=excluded.normalized_content,language_code=excluded.language_code,token_count=excluded.token_count,content_hash=excluded.content_hash,metadata=excluded.metadata
RETURNING id::text chunk_id,document_version_id::text,organization_id::text,chunk_index,title,content,language_code,content_hash,metadata;

nodes.name: Legal Chunk Embedding API
nodes.notes: Retries transient CIC embedding capacity/timeouts. Source vector is validated as 4096 dimensions downstream.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),model AS (
 INSERT INTO embedding_models(model_name,model_version,dimension,provider,distance_metric,normalization,is_active,metadata)
 VALUES('qwen3-embedding-8b','cic-ai-api',1024,'cic-ai-api','cosine','l2',true,jsonb_build_object('source_dimension',4096,'storage_dimension',1024))
 ON CONFLICT(provider,model_name,model_version,dimension) DO UPDATE SET metadata=embedding_models.metadata||excluded.metadata
 RETURNING id
)
SELECT data->>'chunk_id' chunk_id,data->>'document_version_id' document_version_id,data->>'organization_id' organization_id,(data->>'chunk_index')::int chunk_index,data->>'content_hash' content_hash,data->'embedding' embedding,(SELECT id::text FROM model LIMIT 1) embedding_model_id FROM input;

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data)
INSERT INTO legal_chunk_embeddings(chunk_id,organization_id,embedding_model_id,embedding,content_hash,is_active,is_retrievable,metadata)
SELECT (data->>'chunk_id')::uuid,(data->>'organization_id')::uuid,(data->>'embedding_model_id')::uuid,(data->'embedding')::text::vector,data->>'content_hash',true,false,jsonb_build_object('organization_id',data->>'organization_id','document_version_id',data->>'document_version_id','chunk_index',(data->>'chunk_index')::int,'model','qwen3-embedding-8b','dimension',1024,'normalization','l2') FROM input
ON CONFLICT(chunk_id,embedding_model_id,content_hash) DO UPDATE SET embedding=excluded.embedding,is_active=true,is_retrievable=false,metadata=excluded.metadata
RETURNING id::text,chunk_id::text,embedding_model_id::text,content_hash;

WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),b AS (SELECT (data->>'document_version_id')::uuid version_id,(data->>'document_id')::uuid document_id,(data->>'run_id')::uuid run_id FROM input),counts AS (
 SELECT count(DISTINCT c.id)::int total_chunks,count(DISTINCT e.chunk_id)::int total_embeddings FROM b JOIN legal_document_chunks c ON c.document_version_id=b.version_id LEFT JOIN legal_chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id=c.id AND e.content_hash=c.content_hash AND e.is_active
),valid AS (SELECT * FROM counts WHERE total_chunks>0 AND total_chunks=total_embeddings),
old_off AS (UPDATE legal_document_versions v SET is_current=false FROM b,valid WHERE v.document_id=b.document_id AND v.id<>b.version_id AND v.is_current RETURNING v.id),
old_embeddings_off AS (UPDATE legal_chunk_embeddings e SET is_retrievable=false FROM legal_document_chunks c,old_off o WHERE c.document_version_id=o.id AND e.chunk_id=c.id RETURNING e.id),
version_on AS (UPDATE legal_document_versions v SET parse_status='completed',chunk_status='completed',embedding_status='completed',index_status='completed',is_current=true FROM b,valid WHERE v.id=b.version_id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM old_embeddings_off)>=0 RETURNING v.id,v.extracted_fields),
new_embeddings_on AS (UPDATE legal_chunk_embeddings e SET is_retrievable=true FROM legal_document_chunks c,version_on v WHERE c.document_version_id=v.id AND e.chunk_id=c.id RETURNING e.id),
doc_on AS (UPDATE legal_documents d SET status='active',is_official=true,document_type=coalesce(nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,document_type}',''),'other'),title=coalesce(nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,title}',''),d.file_name),document_number=nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,document_number}',''),issuing_authority=nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,issuing_authority}',''),jurisdiction='VN',issued_date=nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,issued_date}','')::date,effective_date=nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,effective_date}','')::date,expiry_date=nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,expiry_date}','')::date,legal_status=coalesce(nullif(v.extracted_fields#>>'{legal_metadata,legal_status}',''),'unknown'),metadata=(d.metadata-'pending_source_hash')||jsonb_build_object('corpus','VN_CONSTRUCTION_LAW','topics',coalesce(v.extracted_fields#>'{legal_metadata,topics}','[]'::jsonb),'metadata_validated',true) FROM b,version_on v WHERE d.id=b.document_id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM new_embeddings_on)>0 RETURNING d.id),
run_done AS (UPDATE legal_ingestion_runs r SET status='completed',completed_at=now(),error_code=null,error_message=null FROM b,doc_on d WHERE r.id=b.run_id RETURNING r.id)
SELECT b.document_id::text,b.version_id::text document_version_id,b.run_id::text,c.total_chunks,c.total_embeddings,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM run_done) rag_complete FROM b CROSS JOIN counts c;

nodes.name: Finalize Legal Version
nodes.notes: Atomically exposes only a version with one valid embedding per stored chunk.

parameters.jsCode: const f=$json;const src=$('Begin Legal Document Version').item.json;return [{json:{status:'completed',corpus:src.corpus,file_id:src.file_id,file_name:src.file_name,document_id:f.document_id,document_version_id:f.document_version_id,total_chunks:f.total_chunks,total_embeddings:f.total_embeddings,is_official:true}}];

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data),b AS (SELECT data,nullif(data->>'run_id','')::uuid run_id,nullif(data->>'document_version_id','')::uuid version_id,nullif(data->>'document_id','')::uuid document_id FROM input),
emb_off AS (UPDATE legal_chunk_embeddings e SET is_retrievable=false FROM legal_document_chunks c,b WHERE b.version_id IS NOT NULL AND c.document_version_id=b.version_id AND e.chunk_id=c.id RETURNING e.id),
ver_fail AS (UPDATE legal_document_versions v SET chunk_status='failed',embedding_status='failed',index_status='failed',is_current=false FROM b WHERE b.version_id IS NOT NULL AND v.id=b.version_id AND (SELECT count(*) FROM emb_off)>=0 RETURNING v.id),
run_fail AS (UPDATE legal_ingestion_runs r SET status='failed',completed_at=now(),error_code=left(coalesce(b.data->>'error_code','INGESTION_FAILED'),100),error_message=left(coalesce(b.data->>'error_message','legal ingestion failed'),500) FROM b WHERE b.run_id IS NOT NULL AND r.id=b.run_id RETURNING r.id),
doc_fail AS (UPDATE legal_documents d SET status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM legal_document_versions v WHERE v.document_id=d.id AND v.is_current) THEN d.status ELSE 'failed' END FROM b WHERE b.document_id IS NOT NULL AND d.id=b.document_id RETURNING d.id)
SELECT 'failed' status,b.data->>'file_id' file_id,b.data->>'file_name' file_name,coalesce(b.data->>'error_code','INGESTION_FAILED') error_code,left(coalesce(b.data->>'error_message','legal ingestion failed'),500) error_message FROM b;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [JSON.stringify({run_id:String($('Reserve Legal Source').item.json.run_id||''),document_id:String($('Reserve Legal Source').item.json.document_id||''),document_version_id:$('Begin Legal Document Version').isExecuted?String($('Begin Legal Document Version').item.json.document_version_id||''):'',file_id:String($('Reserve Legal Source').item.json.file_id||''),file_name:String($('Reserve Legal Source').item.json.file_name||''),error_code:'LEGAL_INGESTION_FAILED',error_message:String($json.error?.message||$json.message||$json.error||'legal ingestion failed').slice(0,500)})] }}

nodes.name: Mark Legal Ingestion Failed
nodes.notes: Keeps partial versions non-current/non-retrievable and records a bounded failure.
